scope_notes: RM-CONNECTOR-01 bounded import inventory only; no connector migration or runtime changes.
Namespaces follow AGENTS.md Package Relationships: current agent_utilities and historic agent_orchestration.
All tracked and nonignored untracked Python source, including tests and scripts. Each imported symbol has a separate disposition.
Initial dispositions by Codex; independent review pending. Categories describe current use, not approval to keep dependencies.

RM-CONNECTOR-01 requires dispositions for dynamic imports, not a finite runtime module list. Six open loader call sites retain target=null and require individually reviewed, full-source-digest-bound classifications. New, changed, missing, duplicate or stale boundary dispositions fail. --discover still exits 1 for runtime-unknown targets; a successful check does not assert static target resolution.

Existing fleet_census and dependency_readiness remain authorities for fleet dependency edges. Their private helpers omit per-symbol classifications and broader aliases, so this standalone stdlib checker does not import the runtime package.

Five formerly unknown calls resolve from source: AUTHORITY_MODULE is repository_manager.governance.concept_reservation in concept_coordination/client.py, re-exported by concept_coordination/__init__.py and consumed by concept_actions.py and tests/test_concept_actions.py (four calls); the package initializer iterates CORE_MODULES=[repository_manager.repository_manager] (one call). These targets are outside the orchestration namespaces. Resolver tests cover source changes, shadowing, cycles and unresolved computed values.
